adminMessage.title: Admin Message
adminMessage.description: Internal error detail for admins. Do not show to the user.

answerCaptureTemplate.title: Answer Capture Template
answerCaptureTemplate.description: Legacy internal answer capture template. Do not display directly; currentQuestion owns the Enhanced Chat renderer.

answersJson.title: Answers JSON
answersJson.description: Updated accumulated answers JSON. Pass to the next SmartIntake action.

brandingJson.title: Branding JSON
brandingJson.description: Branding configuration for the SmartIntake experience.

consentMessage.title: Consent Message
consentMessage.description: Message to show when consent is required before continuing.

currentQuestion.title: Current Question Contract
currentQuestion.description: Structured next question contract for the SmartIntakeQuestionLTI custom renderer.

errorCode.title: Error Code
errorCode.description: Machine-readable error code for debugging failed action runs.

errorType.title: Error Type
errorType.description: Category of error when success is false.

intakeSessionId.title: Intake Session Id
intakeSessionId.description: Session id to pass to every subsequent SmartIntake action.

isComplete.title: Is Complete
isComplete.description: True when all required intake questions are answered.

primaryRecordId.title: Primary Record Id
primaryRecordId.description: Salesforce record id after final save. Usually blank for this action.

progressJson.title: Progress JSON
progressJson.description: Progress state for rendering or summarizing intake completion.

questionJson.title: Question JSON
questionJson.description: Full next-question details including text, type, options, and validation metadata.

requiresConsent.title: Requires Consent
requiresConsent.description: True when the user must accept consent before continuing.

requiresFinalConfirmation.title: Requires Final Confirmation
requiresFinalConfirmation.description: True when all answers are collected and final confirmation is needed.

success.title: Success
success.description: False if the answer could not be saved or validated.

templateKey.title: Template Key
templateKey.description: Echo of the template key used for this intake session.

userMessage.title: User Message
userMessage.description: User-facing message to show when present, especially validation errors or next-step guidance.
